text_block_list.text:
Since Furioso had sustained an injury 
during training, I brought her to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for making you worry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
However, we still have the rest of our 
training. Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Now that you're injured, the girls from 
the JRA will take advantage if you show 
any weakness.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"‘Are you okay?’ ‘Don't push yourself.’ 
‘Let's run together next time’... and so 
on."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh! Such sweet talk! I will never be 
swayed by that!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's train so I can shake off 
this haze!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —! The goal is... not to remain unmoved.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I was swept up in the fever of 
the moment.

And so, Furioso ended up dedicating 
herself to treating her injury.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'm getting impatient, losing my focus... 
Could this be... the URA's—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...No. It is simply my own inadequacy.

Furioso worsened her injury and had to 
take a break from training for a while.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The wind feels so nice. It's 
almost as if it's giving me a push from 
behind.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: The Central... I will not lose to them.

Furioso managed not to worsen her injury 
and went on to make a smooth recovery.
